edited: Looking at spatial scan data (`scanspatial`) linked to projects (`projects.arcregistry` = `scanspatial.arcref`), which funding sources (`projects.fundflux`, treating a missing source as its own group) are bigger than average? For the sources above the average size across funding sources, give one row with the average of their ratios, their combined size, and how far on average they exceed the average size. No rounding. queries:
WITH funding_sources AS (
    SELECT
        p.fundflux,
        AVG(s.boxy * 1.0 / NULLIF(s.boxz, 0)) AS avg_ratio,
        COUNT(*) AS size
    FROM scanspatial AS s
    JOIN projects AS p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref
    GROUP BY p.fundflux
),
average_size AS (
    SELECT AVG(size) AS size FROM funding_sources
)
SELECT
    AVG(f.avg_ratio) AS avg_ratio,
    SUM(f.size) AS combined_size,
    AVG(f.size - a.size) AS avg_excess_size
FROM funding_sources AS f
CROSS JOIN average_size AS a
WHERE f.size > a.size

WITH source_stats AS (
    SELECT
        p.fundflux,
        AVG(s.boxy / NULLIF(s.boxz, 0)) AS avg_ratio,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN s.boxy IS NOT NULL AND s.boxz IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS source_size
    FROM scanspatial AS s
    JOIN projects AS p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref
    GROUP BY p.fundflux
),
size_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(source_size) AS avg_size
    FROM source_stats
)
SELECT
    AVG(source_stats.avg_ratio) AS avg_ratio,
    SUM(source_stats.source_size) AS combined_size,
    AVG(source_stats.source_size - size_average.avg_size) AS avg_size_excess
FROM source_stats
CROSS JOIN size_average
WHERE source_stats.source_size > size_average.avg_size

WITH funding_sources AS (
    SELECT
        p.fundflux,
        AVG(s.boxy / NULLIF(s.boxz, 0)) AS avg_ratio,
        COUNT(DISTINCT p.arcregistry) AS source_size
    FROM scanspatial AS s
    JOIN projects AS p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref
    GROUP BY p.fundflux
),
average_size AS (
    SELECT AVG(source_size) AS size_across_sources
    FROM funding_sources
)
SELECT
    AVG(f.avg_ratio) AS average_ratio,
    SUM(f.source_size) AS combined_size,
    AVG(f.source_size - a.size_across_sources) AS average_excess_size
FROM funding_sources AS f
CROSS JOIN average_size AS a
WHERE f.source_size > a.size_across_sources

WITH funding_sources AS (
  SELECT p.fundflux,
         AVG(s.boxy) / AVG(s.boxz) AS ratio,
         COUNT(*) AS size
  FROM scanspatial AS s
  JOIN projects AS p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref
  GROUP BY p.fundflux
),
average_size AS (
  SELECT AVG(size) AS size FROM funding_sources
)
SELECT AVG(f.ratio) AS average_ratio,
       SUM(f.size) AS combined_size,
       AVG(f.size - a.size) AS average_excess_size
FROM funding_sources AS f
CROSS JOIN average_size AS a
WHERE f.size > a.size
